message: ハクを愛する

name: Misa
message: 「Let's hear your side of the story right away, shall we?」

name: Taishou
message: 「Eee」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, hmm. Because you wanted white cloth... I see.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why weren't mine good enough, I wonder!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because they're not white... probably.」
Judging by that, the victims like Shio-chan and Sacchin must have been wearing white underwear.
Wait, even saying that seriously is so embarrassing!!

name: Misa
message: 「It doesn't seem like they were stolen for any particularly indecent purpose.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd love to hear what kind of 'indecent' things you mean, yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Th-That kind of thing... how should I know!?」
Misa glares over at me.
Indecent...

name: Ria
message: 「No way, Synn-kun!! Thinking about that kinda stuff is for when you're a liiittle bit bigger!!」
Does that mean I just need to wait one more year?

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, don't bring up weird topics!」
Anyway, regardless of whether this demon is male or female, it was simply collecting white cloth.
Apparently, it wanted to stitch the white cloth together to make white clothes.
It must have happened to find white panties in the locker room and been lying in wait here the whole time.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, stealing them isn't a good thing to do, you know.」

name: Taishou
message: 「Eee」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, it's surprisingly reasonable.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, Master Synn is the Demo--whoa there, close call.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey!」
What are we gonna do if you say something suggestive and everyone finds out?!

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I feel kind of bad just chasing it away like this...」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. Do you have any good ideas?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I, um... I-I'm sorry.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You only got striped panties? What a useless broad.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're cute when you keep quiet, so just shut up!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Something white... something white... Ah! Hold on a second」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it was around here--found it!」

name: Misa
message: 「A bedsheet?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was given a worn-out bedsheet a while back. I've been cutting it into small pieces to use as rags. Hopefully this will do the trick」

name: Taishou
message: 「Eee♪」

name: Misa
message: 「So it didn't have to be underwear after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured as long as it wasn't for some indecent purpose, it'd probably be fine」

name: Ria
message: 「He looks super happy about it♪」
The demon walked away with a satisfied smile on his face. He never showed up again after that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Congrats on wrapping that up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, wanting white clothes--what a peculiar demon~」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah. In the Demon World, pitch black and blood red are super popular, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so~? The Demon World sure has terrible taste~」

name: Sally
message: 「Still better than angels, who only have anemic white as an option」

name: Synn
message: 「Makes sense! So white is unpopular and in short supply, which is why he came to the Human World」

name: Sally
message: 「Even on Demon World Mail-Order, white-based outfits are ultra-rare collector's items. Mine included, by the way!!」

name: Misa
message: 「None of that matters」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that--!?」

name: Misa
message: 「We can't just ignore the fact that a suspicious intruder was waltzing right through the academy」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you're right. We need to make sure everyone at the academy, our guests, and the folks in the shopping district can feel safe」

name: Misa
message: 「We'll need to tighten security even further」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh-huh, that's the spirit. You two are really starting to get in sync\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, quit joking around」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun. I hope you don't let that go to your head. The results of our match only ended up tied by pure, lucky coincidence!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think the match has anything to do with this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Maybe I shouldn't have left those two alone after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Waaah, don't call out to me all of a sudden!!」

name: Ria
message: 「By the way, these bloomers... aren't they Misa-chan's?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugya.」

name: Misa
message: 「I completely forgot about them...」

name: Ria
message: 「...? C-Could they be yours, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be bad if she gets the wrong idea. Let's just apologize honestly.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's the wisest course of action.」

name: Synn & Misa
message: 「Ria-senpai!! We are terribly sorry!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They really are in sync, aren't they?」

name: Sally
message: 「Spot-on!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shuuuut uuuup!!」
